exposure: Two groups based on morphine dosage: RM3 group (3mg morphine) and RM6 group (6mg morphine)
low-concentration ropivacaine via continuous basal infusion
outcome: pain intensity at rest and movement
incidence and severity of postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV)
cohort: 531 parturients who received epidural analgesia for cesarean section
finding: Epidural 3mg morphine plus 0.1% ropivacaine in a continuous basal infusion mode provides equal pain relief compared to 6mg morphine, but with a lower incidence of urinary retention.
